name: Savings Jar
description: Funds set aside for a wallet until a chosen time. Anyone can pay into a jar. After its unlock time, the owner of the wallet it belongs to can empty it by approving the withdrawal with that wallet. Replacing the wallet's owner key changes who can empty the jar, never when.

saver.name: Saver
saver.description: Pays into a savings jar, or keeps track of one.

deposit.name: Pay into a savings jar
deposit.description: Lock funds for a wallet until the jar's unlock time.

withdraw.name: Empty a savings jar
withdraw.description: Return everything in the jar to the wallet. Possible only after the jar's unlock time.

depositTransaction.name: Paid into a savings jar
depositTransaction.description: $(<savedSatoshis>) satoshis were locked in a savings jar.

withdrawTransaction.name: Emptied a savings jar
withdrawTransaction.description: The savings jar was emptied into the wallet.

savingsJarInput.name: Savings jar
savingsJarInput.description: The jar being emptied. It needs no signature of its own: the wallet's approval releases it.

savingsJarOutput.name: Savings jar
savingsJarOutput.description: $(<savedSatoshis>) satoshis locked until the jar's unlock time.

savingsJarLockingScript.name: Savings jar
savingsJarLockingScript.description: Funds locked until the unlock time, then spendable in a transaction approved by the owner of the wallet the jar belongs to.

identity.name: Wallet identity
identity.description: The token category that identifies the wallet the jar belongs to.

unlockTime.name: Unlock time
unlockTime.description: When the jar can be emptied, as a Unix timestamp.

savedSatoshis.name: Amount to save
savedSatoshis.description: Satoshis to lock in the jar.
